move.text:
Dear partner,
Thank you very much for your message - we are very glad about your interest in our company.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €17.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery DAP.
Please let me explain.
To achieve this reduction, we must maintain the delivery terms at EXW, as a shift to DAP would significantly increase the costs.
Furthermore, please provide the detailed delivery schedule for the 6,000 pieces so we can properly evaluate your volume commitment.
Alternatively, with delivery EXW: €16.50 per unit.
Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.
Which volume can you commit to?
Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.
We are fully committed to winning your business and to becoming a long-term partner for your team.
Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
